title: Branches
body:
If added, new Branch blocks would generate on trees.
They can be walked through and have a chance of dropping either nothing, or a wooden log.

( Likely won't spawn as often as in this screenshot, this is a general example of how they look )

![image: Branches](media/1458020684511973476.png)

**Update (February 3, 2026):** These will not be added.
